title: Real-Time Face Detection System
subtitle: AI-POWERED COMPUTER VISION
description: An AI-powered face detection system built using the YOLO object detection model. The system analyzes visual input, identifies faces, and draws bounding boxes around detected faces, demonstrating the practical application of deep learning and computer vision.
impact: Implemented a YOLO-based face detection pipeline that locates faces in visual input and highlights detected faces using bounding boxes.

howItWorks.title: Visual Input Processing
howItWorks.description: Receives visual input and prepares image frames for analysis by the YOLO detection model.

howItWorks.title: YOLO Face Detection
howItWorks.description: Uses the YOLO model to identify faces in the input and locate their positions within the image.

howItWorks.title: Bounding Box Visualization
howItWorks.description: Draws rectangular bounding boxes around detected faces to make detection results easy to visualize.
